title: Reference Subtraction for Voiceprint Recognition: code, features, split manifest, and predictions
description: Reproducibility package for H. Saied, "Reference Subtraction for Voiceprint Recognition: A Discriminative Approach Based on the Group's Normal Range" (ICPIC 2026). Contains feature extraction and experiment code, 67-dimensional features for 605 recordings, the train/test split manifest, sample-level predictions of all eight decision rules, and the scripts that verify the algebraic reductions, paired McNemar tests, bootstrap intervals, and session analysis reported in the paper.

creators.name: Saied, Husham
